title: Clerk icon-grid band
description: A near-black notched band with one or two centred columns, each with a coloured eyebrow, a two-line heading, muted copy and a caret link over a hairline grid of tall empty tiles holding thin line icons. Dashed guide lines run on past the grid, fading out.
notes: made for SDK / integration lists; icons come in as props (thin line icons look best)
a group with three or fewer icons gets double-height tiles on desktop so it matches a six-icon neighbour
